betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Satellites are in orbit, but how do you actually see what they've found? That's where the §6Satellite Control Center§f comes in.

This multiblock terminal connects to your satellites via a Data Bus and displays everything they've collected: ore maps, biome data, atmospheric readings. The GUI lists every active satellite with its status, orbit, and remaining power, and lets you pull data out as a Data Unit for use in the Astrobody Data Processor.

Place it somewhere with a clear view of the sky. Underground terminals can't receive satellite data. If you're on a space station, put it in a glass-domed room.

§ePS:§f The terminal powers itself at 10,000 RF capacity. Not huge, but it doesn't draw much. Just make sure you have enough for the Data Bus connections too.
